description:
Human gate, not an implementation task. After zaq-h2i.3.12 review/validation, present current channel, SMTP and capability-applicable Web Widget Main/Advanced forms for explicit UX approval. Verify required/optional/fixed/unresolved/not-applicable states, unsupported sending, retry feedback, draft preservation, inactive-tab submission and relevant error-tab selection. Preserve existing capability modal and unrelated SMTP/widget/streamed settings. Prior design discussion is not approval of completed screens. Record the explicit response and reviewed revision. Only then unblock new consolidated E2E authoring in zaq-h2i.3.5. Reuse existing stories/browser/manual inspection; no new components or code in this issue.

Current concrete review artifacts (2026-11-25): /tmp/zaq-h2i-smtp-main.png, /tmp/zaq-h2i-smtp-advanced.png, /tmp/zaq-h2i-channel-main.png, /tmp/zaq-h2i-channel-advanced.png, /tmp/zaq-h2i-widget-main.png, /tmp/zaq-h2i-declarations.png and live Storybook capture /tmp/zaq-h2i-declarations-storybook.png. Existing story source: storybook/components/forms/file_delivery_settings.story.exs. Current Web adapter has no file metadata and correctly shows no file controls; conditional declared widget behavior is proven through compatible existing-callback test producers in the owning LiveView suite. Shared rendered declarations show fixed/required/not-applicable/unsupported/unresolved/retry states. Exact unstaged diff artifact /tmp/zaq-h2i-implementation.patch has SHA256 140e2d5ca541f80080f32798f6f245986eb0578dd8a37880fd06b4406cf05af7; base HEAD 2107c75e5. No UX approval recorded yet; current user approvals cover only identified metadata expectations and unsupported-SMTP hint expectation. Do not treat automated checks or design-direction approval as this gate's completion.

comments.text: Implementation has a browser-inspected concrete UI and Storybook variations; screenshot /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-smtp-file-settings.png. Human approval remains pending. Do not infer approval from screenshots, automated checks, the user's earlier permission to implement, or the manifest update. Consolidated new feature E2E authoring stays blocked. Existing browser journeys are being executed separately as required.

Final UX approval must cover the shared Main/Advanced settings tab layout from zaq-h2i.3.6, including grouped streamed-update/file-delivery sections, draft preservation, inactive-tab errors and whole-form save behavior across channel and SMTP editors. Approval and consolidated E2E remain pending until this final composition is implemented and explicitly reviewed.

Updated SMTP persistence-rejection UX is ready for the existing final review scope: local blank-name error selects Main, all submitted credentials/security/file drafts remain, native Toggle keyboard navigation works, and correcting only the name saves/reloads the drafts. Browser evidence: /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-7-smtp-name-error.png, /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-7-smtp-retained-advanced.png and /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-7-browser-inspection.json. Final human UX approval remains pending; no new feature E2E specs authored and no precommit run.

Ready for explicit human UX review. Review current artifacts and unstaged diff recorded in this description. Final automatic validation: 839 integrated checks plus targeted review checks; mix q passed; existing browser suite 590 passed/3 skipped. Approval has not been given for the completed screens; .3.5 and .3.13 remain gated. No code commit/push/merge/publication.
